text:
incident-bot: 🚨 PagerDuty page fired for service=redwood-inference-inference-prod (high) — incident id=INC-99321 — routed to escalation_policy=platform-oncall -> bindings: platform, security-shadow

alex: whoa, I just got a page but I'm not on prod rota right now. looks like it went to the wrong team. :confused:

maria: same — i wasn't expecting this. PD shows secondary binding to 'security-shadow-service' which shouldn't be hooked to prod alerts.

jamal: pulling PD audit logs now. give me a sec.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-99321 acknowledged by linda at 2358002490

linda: acked because phone rang. I don't have the context — I'm platform oncall but this looks like it bubbled through a shadow binding.

alex: can someone paste the service binding? I suspect a schedule sync hit replaced the primary with a legacy shadow entry.

maria: here's the snippet from PD audit: "service":{"id":"svc_47","name":"inference-prod","integrations":[{"type":"webhook"}],"escalation_policy":{"id":"ep_12"},"bindings":[{"target":"platform-oncall","type":"schedule"},{"target":"security-shadow","type":"legacy-binding"}]}

jamal: confirmed in PD logs: at 2358002405 an automated sync job (ops-scheduler) added a legacy-binding for security-shadow because the migration flag was off. ops-scheduler job id=job-ops-2026-03-14-20:40

ops-sched-bot: executed schedule-sync job-ops-2026-03-14-20:40 status=success changed_bindings=1

alex: that explains it. we need to rollback the binding immediately — pages going to the wrong responders is causing noise and potential missed SLAs.

maria: temporary mitigation: suppress escalation policy on the shadow binding and rebind the service to platform-only. I'll open a PD API patch.

jamal: i'm on PD now. command: `curl -X PATCH https://api.pagerduty.com/services/svc_47 -H "Authorization: Token token=***" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"service":{"bindings":[{"target":"platform-oncall","type":"schedule"}]}}'`

linda: hold off on full patch until we confirm impact. customers reporting elevated 500s? ops dashboard shows errors spike at 2358002390.

alex: right — alert was for request-latency > 1000ms and 502 errors. need to confirm whether this is causally linked or just correlated noise from paging.

maria: patch applied (rolled back legacy binding) at 2358002502. PD shows bindings now platform-only.

pagerduty-bot: Binding update for service svc_47 successful. previous_bindings_count=2 current_bindings_count=1

jamal: can everyone stop receiving pages? Linda, did your PD phone stop?

linda: yes, no further pages after 2358002505.

alex: great. next: quick mitigation for customers — we see a 6% elevated 502 rate from the inference cluster. I'm running `kubectl get pods` and scaling the inference pool by +2 replicas as a short-term buffer.

maria: also rolling CG cache restart for the gateway at 2358002518 — may cut transient errors.

jamal: PD incident INC-99321 annotated: "root cause suspected: ops-scheduler schedule-sync added legacy binding; secondary effect: noisy pages to shadow service. customer impact: increased 502s between 2358002380-2358002520 affecting ~3% of requests in EU region."

alex: can we get concrete numbers for customer impact? Grafana: 502_count=312 (over 20m), p95 latency increased from 120ms to 1.1s, user-visible failures ~0.9% of requests to inference endpoint.

linda: filing a short customer note draft: "We saw a transient increase in errors for inference calls in EU due to a routing and autoscaling perturbation. Services are stable; mitigation applied. Followup: audit schedule-sync job and block legacy bindings." I'll paste draft in the incident ticket.

maria: postmortem action items (quick): 1) ops-scheduler: add whitelist/blacklist to prevent legacy-binding re-adds, 2) PD test harness: run end-to-end schedule-sync dry-run in staging, 3) add automatic rollback if binding divergence detected, 4) playbook: immediate steps to revoke/shutoff shadow bindings.

jamal: jotting down runbook changes. also recommending an integration test that asserts expected binding_count==1 for prod services.

ops-sched-bot: created followup ticket TKT-885: ops-scheduler fix + PD dry-run. assigned to ops-team.

alex: handing to morning shift: maria will take the followup and do the postmortem. I'm wrapping up the oncall context and leaving notes for next rotation.

maria: i'll own postmortem and coordinate with security to ensure shadow service isn't used by other teams. thanks all. :thumbsup:

linda: leaving a note in the rotation handoff: "was paged by INC-99321 due to legacy binding; incident mitigated and bindings reverted; followups created TKT-885; monitor EU 502s."

incident-bot: Incident INC-99321 status=resolved at 2358002542 — duration ~74s — responders: linda, alex, maria, jamal

alex: closing thread. we should schedule a short sync tomorrow to review the ops-scheduler change before the next release window. :calendar:
